entries.376dfe4d9ae877bf: A company that operates education portal sites for finding cram schools and schools, such as "Juku Navi" and "Minna no Gakko Joho".
entries.402492d8d1f96c69: This is a portal site that comprehensively provides information useful for choosing schools, including nursery schools, kindergartens, elementary schools, junior high schools, senior high schools, vocational schools and universities. It publishes reviews from current students and parents and deviation value rankings, and focuses on the field of vocational schools.
entries.4b140b741cb43001: This is a single-segment business that operates, across markets such as early childhood education, cram schools, preparatory schools, home tutor dispatch and correspondence education, portal sites each specialized in a particular field. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥3,669 million.
entries.680fe74f930bd770: Parents looking for extracurricular lesson classes
entries.80a2e599601b4bca: Education providers such as cram schools, preparatory schools and schools
entries.866e62eb78d434a2: Students and parents looking for cram schools and preparatory schools
entries.c475efdd7e0dbee7: This is a portal site where children from preschool age through high school students and their parents can search for and compare cram schools and preparatory schools that suit their goals. As of October 31, 2025, the number of listed classrooms was more than 110,000, and the annual number of visitors for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was more than 13,870,000.
entries.e6ed3c431f16db70: This is an information portal site for preparatory schools specializing in medical school entrance examinations. According to analysis by management, it is one of the growth businesses and grew significantly over the full fiscal year.
entries.f692500f208b9fad: Students and parents looking for schools
entries.f7df4e5fcfd36d97: Examinees and parents aiming for medical school entrance
entries.f95c929766cd4afc: Users and parents looking for cram schools, schools and extracurricular lessons
entries.ffda0184f3aad63f: This is a portal site where users can compare extracurricular lesson classes for children from infancy through elementary school age (such as English conversation, swimming, piano and programming) and apply for trial lessons.
